profile.headline: Graphic designer, Website Developer, and always a student
profile.summary: I create graphic designs and logo designs for local small businesses. I am currently in collage for Business Administration. I have two years experience as a graphic designer, it’s more of a passion than a job.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: At Referral Advertising, I specialize in website design, logo creation, and branding for small businesses, making them legit online. Proficient in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace

positions.title: Website Developer
positions.description: I develop websites in marketing strategies for small businesses.

company.name: The George Washington University School of Business

positions.title: Security Officer
positions.description: Skills: Guarding · Customer Experience · Interpersonal Communication

positions.title: Security Professional
positions.description: I monitor one building and their entrances, exit doors and access gates, follow all security and safety regulations, oversee the authorized arrivals and departures of visitors, employees, and guests.

positions.title: Direct Support Professional
positions.description: I helped residents (both intellectually disabled and the elderly) with their daily duties such as meal prep/cooking, light housekeeping, medication administration; engaged them with creative and sensory based activities and games.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I worked with the primary teacher to manage the classroom, implemented daily lesson plans under the supervision of the primary teacher; ensured the classroom was safe, oversaw students during break times, lunch, and dismissal, assisted with student assessments and communication to parents.

positions.title: Salesperson
positions.description: I accepted cash, checks and bank cards for payment, provided excellent customer service, and maintained a clean, tidy, and orderly work area.
